Overview

Esmeraldas is a city in E with a population of 200,000. Ecuador’s main Pacific oil port, a hot and humid coastal city with Afro-Ecuadorian cultural heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
